title: The Uniform of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Ansel Winterbourne
blurb: Ivo Marchetti, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
